name: Expressions
description: Safe arithmetic expression evaluation for calculators and derived values.

operations.name: expr.evaluate
operations.description: Evaluates an arithmetic expression string and returns its numeric value.

inputs.name: expression
inputs.description: Arithmetic expression: + - * / % ^, parentheses, unary minus, sqrt/abs/floor/ceil/round, two-argument min/max/pow, and the constants pi and e

operations.howto: Calculator pattern: bind expression from the input element ({"source": "ui-element", "sourceId": "expr-in"}) and wire the operation to a Calculate button click; route the value output to a state key shown by a text element (add a round transform on the display binding for fixed decimals). Everything runs locally; no network. A malformed expression, division by zero, or sqrt of a negative number is an error.
